questions.stem: What does the term Data Sprawl refer to?
options: The physical distance between an organisation's data centres
The staggering amount and variety of data produced by businesses every day
The growth of a single database table beyond its partition limit
The spread of customer ages in a marketing dataset
Unauthorised copying of data outside the company network
questions.explanation: Data Sprawl is the staggering amount and variety of data that businesses produce daily, scattered across many formats and systems.

questions.stem: What is the main cause of Data Sprawl in a company?
options: Employees deleting old files too slowly
A shortage of database administrators
Storing all data in a single data warehouse
The variety of enterprise software, mobile apps, storage systems and data formats each company relies on
Over-use of standardised formats
questions.explanation: Sprawl arises largely because each company depends on many different applications, storage systems and data formats.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as one of the formats in which sprawling data appears?
options: Parquet
Video
Email
PDF
XML
questions.explanation: The formats named are Video, Audio, Email, PDF, JSON, XML and Text; Parquet is not among them.

questions.stem: In the analogy of doing your taxes with papers hidden in drawers, closets and couch cushions, what does the mixture of forms written in Greek, English and Spanish represent?
options: The need for multilingual support staff
Data that has been encrypted
Records lost through poor backups
Duplicate data held by different departments
Data scattered across different formats and copies that must be reconciled before it is useful
questions.explanation: The scattered, duplicated papers in different languages illustrate data spread across many formats and copies, which is the state Data Sprawl creates.

questions.stem: Why does Data Sprawl make extracting information challenging or time-consuming?
options: Because sprawling data is always encrypted
Because no database can hold more than one format
Because information cannot easily be extracted unless all the formats are converted into a standardised format
Because decision-makers refuse to use unstructured data
Because sprawling data is stored on tape
questions.explanation: With data scattered in different formats, extraction stays hard until everything is converted into one standardised format.

questions.stem: Which phrase captures the essence of addressing Data Sprawl?
options: Converting multi-format datasets into one unified format
Deleting all data older than one year
Storing every format in its native system
Replacing the data warehouse with a data lake
Restricting data creation to a single application
questions.explanation: The key statement is that Data Sprawl is about converting multi-format datasets into one unified format.

questions.stem: To mitigate the challenge of Data Sprawl for decision support, what must be done with semi-structured and unstructured datasets?
options: Archive them to cold storage
Keep them in their original formats for auditors
Encrypt them before analysis
Convert them into structured data
Discard them, since decisions only need structured data
questions.explanation: The mitigation is to convert all semi-structured and unstructured datasets into structured data for decision support.

questions.stem: Which system currently acts as the serving layer for decision-makers?
options: The email server
The Data Warehouse
The mobile application back end
The document management system
The operational database
questions.explanation: The Data Warehouse is currently the serving layer that decision-makers rely on.

questions.stem: Who is said to be affected by the problem of Data Sprawl?
options: Only social media companies
Only organisations without a data warehouse
Only companies that store video and audio
Only government tax agencies
Companies across the world
questions.explanation: Data Sprawl is described as a problem that is starting to plague companies across the world.

questions.stem: Which statement about Data Sprawl is NOT correct?
options: It involves data in many formats such as JSON, XML, Text and Audio
It is driven by the variety of software and storage systems a company uses
It is resolved simply by buying more storage capacity
It makes information extraction time-consuming until formats are standardised
It is compared to tax papers scattered around a house
questions.explanation: Sprawl is a problem of variety and format, not capacity; the remedy is converting datasets into a unified, structured format rather than adding storage.
